newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust runs Continental benefits.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust runs Continental benefits.

text.p: Bankers Trust Corp said on Wednesday Continental Airlines appointed it master trustee for the airline's defined benefit plan, which had assets over $500 million.
The working relationship between Bankers Trust and Continental began October 1, the company said.
Bankers Trust also provides Continental with recordkeeping, performance measurement and benefit payment services, it said.
Continental also used the bank's on-line reporting system which accesses trust accounting, custody, performance measurement and securities lending data, Bankers said.
